Illness began with two episodes of vomiting which have now resolved

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient feels very dehydrated with poor oral fluid intake, low appetite, and minimal solid intake

History_of_Present_Illness.content: No recent takeaway or suspicious food consumption
Symptom onset occurred at home while working
Otherwise fit and well prior to this illness

Family_History.content: Father died of bowel cancer approximately 10 years ago
Family_History.source_text: died of bowel ca ~10 yrs ago

Social_and_Family_History.content: Has been off work for the past 3 days

Assessment.content: Acute gastroenteritis characterized by 3 days of watery diarrhea 5–6 times per day, initial vomiting now resolved, no blood or abdominal pain, transient early fever, poor oral intake, and weakness
Assessment.source_text: 1) Acute gastroenteritis — 3 days watery diarrhea 5–6/d; initial vmt resolved; no blood or abdo pain; transient early fever; poor PO intake; weakness

Plan_of_Care.content: Encourage oral fluids and use of oral rehydration solution such as Dioralyte from pharmacy
Plan_of_Care.source_text: Oral rehydration: encourage fluids; ORS (Dioralyte) from pharmacy

Plan_of_Care.content: Paracetamol as needed if feeling feverish or weak
Rest and remain off work for the next 1–2 days
Return to work after being diarrhea-free for 24–48 hours
Review if symptoms have not improved by next week
Plan_of_Care.source_text: Review if not improved by next week

Follow_up_Information.content: Follow up if not improved by next week
